product.title: Half-Day Columbia River Gorge and Waterfall Tour

description.text: Head to the Columbia River Gorge for a half-day tour of cascading waterfalls and scenic overlooks from Portland. Visit Multnomah Falls, Latourell Falls, Vista House, Bridal Veil Falls, and Portland Women's Forum viewpoints with optional mini-hikes when conditions allow.

highlights: Half-day waterfall tour in the Columbia River Gorge
Visit Multnomah Falls and Latourell Falls
Stop at Vista House and Portland Women's Forum viewpoints
Optional short hikes for closer waterfall views

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.

product.itinerarySummary: Head to the Columbia River Gorge for a half-day tour of cascading waterfalls and scenic overlooks from Portland.

itineraryItems.title: Portland departure
itineraryItems.description: Meet the guide and group before driving east to the gorge.

itineraryItems.title: Multnomah Falls
itineraryItems.description: Stop at Oregon's tallest waterfall for photos and viewing time.

itineraryItems.title: Latourell Falls
itineraryItems.description: Hike or view the plunge-style falls surrounded by basalt cliffs.

itineraryItems.title: Vista House and Bridal Veil Falls
itineraryItems.description: Finish with gorge panoramas and a stop at Bridal Veil Falls State Park.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Half-Day Columbia River Gorge and Waterfall Tour?
Where does the tour depart from in Portland?
faqs.answer: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point listed in your booking confirmation.
